confirmedFindings.title: Non-Atomic Map Merge Corrupts Tenant Usage Metrics
confirmedFindings.body: Concurrent read-modify-write operations on this.usageMap allow parallel worker threads to overwrite tenant usage values, corrupting billing data and enabling tenants to exceed prepaid quotas without detection.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use atomic increments or synchronized map operations for usage aggregation.
